jamie: quick post-all-hands thread — need a concise public pitch and a short internal playbook for sales/eng.

alex: recommended public pitch (15s): "Redwood makes LLM inference predictable: consistent latency, transparent unit costs, and a clear path from hosted to private deployments."

maria: for GTM collateral add migration steps (Hosted → Dedicated → Private) and one FAQ: when to pick Dedicated vs Private. i'll draft.

sam: eng note: add an optional tech blurb: "GPU-optimized runtime with continuous batching, KV caching, and quant-ready execution paths."

lee: benchmarks to standardize: p50 chat latency, p99 tail, and $/1M tokens. share canonical bench link.

ops-bot: canonical bench: https://redwood.internal/bench/2025-q4 (internal)

taylor: sales ask: customers often ask if we're "just another endpoint." reply: start on Hosted; grow into Dedicated/Private for scale, lower unit cost, and compliance.

jamie: action items: alex will finalize the canonical paragraph; maria will add migration doc + FAQ; lee will prepare a 1-page SE cheat sheet; taylor will collect top objections. i'll assemble a slides snippet after.

lee: DM me for raw perf notebooks (internal only).

jamie: thanks all — drop additional Qs here or DM.
